description: This file is a shell script implementing self-healing network connectivity tests such as ping and DNS ping, with mechanisms to perform corrective actions based on the results. It includes functions for generating random delays, parsing URLs, performing network reachability tests, and coordinating repeated checks within an infinite loop governed by a configuration setting.

methods.name: getCorrectiveActionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the corrective action setting using syscfg.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoStartPing
methods.description: Calculates a random delay in seconds based on current time seed, then sleeps for that duration before starting network tests.

methods.name: removehttp
methods.description: Strips the protocol part (http/https) from a URL, returning only the host part.

methods.name: runDNSPingTest
methods.description: Performs a DNS resolution test on a configured URL and takes corrective action if DNS fails and the setting permits.

methods.name: runPingTest
methods.description: Carries out network ping tests to gateway IP addresses and configured servers for both IPv4 and IPv6, including response analysis and corrective actions.
